VAL-BASE-007.evidence: The baseline-report.json exists with model name, TP size=4, GPU memory utilization (~93%), and coding agent TTFT/TPOT/decode tok/s per concurrency. However, synthetic benchmark TTFT and TPOT are stored as 0 in the aggregated report (aggregation bug in generate_baseline_report.py). The raw synthetic result files do contain correct TTFT/TPOT values (e.g., Qwen c1 mean_ttft_ms=880ms). The report is missing correct synthetic TTFT/TPOT values. Also, no explicit 'quantization: FP16' or 'prefill tok/s' field is present in the report (only decode/output throughput).

details.issue: Synthetic TTFT/TPOT values are 0 in aggregated report due to aggregation bug; raw files have correct values

VAL-BASE-008.evidence: Reproducibility data in baseline-report.json shows all runs within 10% variance. Qwen c1: 2.0% diff, c2: 0.01% diff, c4: 0.26% diff. Llama c1: 0.02%, c2: 0.12%, c4: 0.14%. All well within ±10% requirement.

frictions: Stopping vLLM server leaves orphaned worker processes that hold GPU VRAM; need to explicitly kill worker PIDs via rocm-smi --showpids after stopping the API server
Baseline report aggregator (generate_baseline_report.py) stores synthetic TTFT/TPOT as 0 - the raw JSON files have correct values but the aggregate report does not capture them correctly
Server startup between switching models takes 1-2 minutes (Llama ~60s, Qwen ~180s)
